azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝١
الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝٢
مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۝٣
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝٤
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝٥
صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ ۝٦
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. al-hamdu lillahi rabbil-alamin. ar-rahmanir-rahim. maliki yawmid-din. iyyaka nabudu wa iyyaka nasta-in. ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim. siratal-ladhina anamta alayhim ghayril-maghdubi alayhim wa lad-dallin
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path, the path of those You have blessed, not those who have earned Your anger, nor those who have gone astray.

azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۝٢٥٥ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfau indahu illa bi-idhnih. yalamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay-in min ilmihi illa bima sha. wasia kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. wa la yauduhu hifzuhuma wa huwal-aliyyul-azim
azkar.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنْ تُبْدُوا مَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٢٨٤
آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝٢٨٥
لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ ۝٢٨٦
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. lillahi ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard... amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-muminun... la yukallifullahu nafsan illa wusaha...
azkar.translation: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth... The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers... Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity...

azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝٢
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ۝٤
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. lam yalid wa lam yulad. wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. And there is none comparable to Him.

azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝١
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝٢
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝٣
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝٤
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ۝٥
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. qul audhu bi-rabbil-falaq. min sharri ma khalaq. wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-uqad. wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

azkar.text:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝١
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝٢
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝٣
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝٤
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝٥
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ ۝٦
azkar.transliteration: bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim. qul audhu bi-rabbin-nas. malikin-nas. ilahin-nas. min sharril-waswasil-khannas. alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. minal-jinnati wan-nas
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.

azkar.text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
azkar.transliteration: bismillahi arqik, min kulli shayin yu'dhik, min sharri kulli nafsin aw ayni hasid, Allahu yashfik, bismillahi arqik
azkar.translation: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.

azkar.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
azkar.transliteration: allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibil-bas, ishfi antash-shafi, la shifa-a illa shifa-uk, shifa-an la yughadiru saqama
azkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the suffering and heal. You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness.

azkar.text: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ، وَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلَاثًا، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
azkar.transliteration: da yadaka alal-ladhi ta-allama min jasadik, wa qul bismillah thalathan, wa qul sabaa marratin audhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
azkar.translation: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts and say: In the name of Allah, three times. Then say seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I find and fear.

azkar.text: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ، رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
azkar.translation: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you.

azkar.text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
azkar.transliteration: audhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
azkar.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
